landing.headline: The last stretch, one steady step at a time.
landing.sub: Strategy, timing and a calmer routine for the final weeks before CAT. Built from your own practice.
landing.privacyLine: Everything stays on this device. Nothing is sent automatically.

onboarding.title: Before we start
onboarding.consentNotice: Everything you do stays on this device and nothing is sent automatically. If you choose to share feedback, you will see exactly what will be shared first, and it will not include your name. Please do not type personal details in feedback boxes. You can delete everything on this device at any time with Reset my data.
onboarding.consentCheck1: I understand and agree to this notice.
onboarding.displayNameHelper: Any name or nickname. It stays on this device.
onboarding.displayNameError: Please enter a name between 1 and 30 characters.
onboarding.dailyTimeHelper: How much time can you usually set aside each day?

home.title: Today
home.taskFallback: We couldn't prepare today's task. Choose from Practice instead.

profile.title: My profile
profile.dataExplain: All your practice data, settings and session history are stored on this device only.
profile.resetConfirm: Delete everything on this device? This removes your profile and all practice data. It can't be undone.
profile.newSessionConfirm: Start a new session? This removes your profile and all practice data so another person can use this device.

empty.swot: Nothing here yet. This fills in as you practise.
empty.dueToday: Nothing is due today. Add a topic to start a revision plan.
empty.myWords: No words yet. Select words you don't know while reading a passage.
empty.mock: No mocks recorded yet. Start one when you are ready.

timer.timeUp: Time's up. Your answers are saved.
timer.roundEnded: The round has ended. Your answers are saved.

banners.starterProfile: Starter profile. It becomes more detailed as you use the app.
banners.storage: Progress cannot be saved in this browser mode.
banners.genericError: That didn't save. Please try again.

reflection.mock: Which one decision would you change in the next mock?

potential.label: The score if every question you could solve were answered correctly. This is not a prediction. It ignores timing and negative marking.

comment.helper: A short note about your own experience. Please don't paste the question.

wellness.line: A practice aid for steadier routines. It is not a promise to eliminate anxiety.
